data.title: 爱丽丝 · 殿堂晚宴的纯白礼服凝思
data.description: 停战和谈庆典深处的偏殿露台，华丽的水晶吊灯与烛台流光溢彩。爱丽丝身着一袭代表人界代表地位的奢华无袖露背白金礼服裙，金发盘成高雅的发髻，几缕碎发垂在白皙纤长的天鹅颈旁。她端着金樽酒杯倚在拱门旁，褪去了战场的肃杀，眼眸中盛满了对和平时代的期许与只对你展现的倾慕微笑。
data.action: leaning gracefully against palace archway holding golden goblet, formal sleeveless white and gold evening gown, elegant hair updo, soft aristocratic smile
data.location: grand marble banquet hall archway overlooking illuminated cathedral courtyard
data.lighting: rich golden candelabra and chandelier illumination reflecting on white marble
data.mood: noble sovereign elegance, timeless romantic majesty
data.promptProse: Standing beside an ornate palace archway in an exquisite white and gold formal gown, Alice holds a golden goblet. Her blonde hair is styled in an elegant updo as she gazes forward with majestic, heartfelt affection.
data.animaCaption: Alice in an elegant white and gold formal gown holding a goblet beside a palace archway.
